question: To which classes of persons is a prohibition addressed, O goddess?
premises: The reviler of Śiva is listed.
The slanderer and one related to Kula-Bhairava are listed in parallel.
inference: No giving or no relation is posited to the reviler of Śiva, to the slanderer, or to one in relation to Kula-Bhairava, O goddess.
uncertainties: The verb of the prohibition is absent from these tokens.
plain_english: Not to the reviler of Śiva, O goddess, not to the slanderer, not to one in relation to Kula-Bhairava.
